name: Hanako
source: A girl who likes to play games and go to festivals. She works part time at her father's cafe, Tea Masters, to earn a bit of extra money. (But doesn't mind helping herself to some leftoever cake if there is any) She keeps a low profile at school and doesn't dare to dream big. But she has a strength within herself she doesn't know about.
